title: Benchmark Artifact Audit: code and data for auditing sentiment analysis benchmarks
description: Code, hashed indices, human-validated gold annotations, model predictions and aggregate results for the paper 'Are We Benchmarking Models or Dataset Artifacts? A Reproducible Audit Framework for Sentiment Analysis Benchmarks — Evidence from Turkish Low-Resource Benchmarks with English External Validation'. No third-party benchmark texts or original labels are redistributed; they are rebuilt from the user's own copy of each dataset (see DATA_SHARING.md).
